note: PROVISIONAL. IDs = TOPDOWN_V1 already written into the servos by the teammate (2026-11-10). Signs and zero counts are the teammate's robot v1 measurements; zero counts of every joint whose horn or link was remounted for v2 must be re-measured before any motion. The firmware refuses torque-on while verified is false. Joint angle [rad] = sign * (count - zero_count) * 2*pi/4096, model convention of core/robots/custom_biped.py.

imu.note: Body (canonical +X forward, +Y left, +Z up) = R * sensor. Teammate's provisional map body = (-sensorY, sensorX, sensorZ); only forward lean was checked on v1.

servo_gains.note: Teammate's confirmed settings, read back on the bench; not written by this firmware.
